transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, November 18. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. 'India sitting on disaster': Rahul flags 'economic' crisis during US visit; BJP hits back. Rahul Gandhi warned of an impending economic crisis in India, citing unemployment and concerns over the education system during an event at Columbia University in New York. He said India's youth were increasingly frustrated as they saw no future for themselves, pointing to a growing disconnect with their parents over career opportunities. The Congress leader is on a two-day US visit. Will Siraj play first Test versus New Zealand? Morkel leaves final call to Shubman Gill. Morne Morkel addressed concerns regarding Mohammed Siraj's form ahead of the first Test against New Zealand. He emphasized that the final decision on lineup rests with captain Shubman Gill. Morkel expressed confidence in the team's bowling resources to secure the necessary wickets for victory. He also mentioned the importance of managing external distractions to maintain focus. Jantar Mantar protest nod denied due to CJP past conduct: Cops in SC. Delhi Police commissioner Anurag Kumar submitted an affidavit to the Supreme Court regarding a denied protest. The refusal was based on past non-compliance by the Cockroach Janta Party and intelligence inputs warning of potential disorder. Despite the prohibitions, previous protests had been marked by violence and damage to property, necessitating preventive measures. Protesting politicians were removed but not arrested, with the police ensuring their basic needs were met. Nvidia board rejects Jensen Huang's return as CEO, says interim chief Colette Kress. Following Jensen Huang's unexpected departure, Nvidia's board has announced that he will not be returning as CEO. Interim CEO Colette Kress highlighted the organization's commitment to growth and fulfilling stakeholder needs. Concerns about customer relations after Huang's exit have been addressed, signaling sustained interest in Nvidia's offerings. Kress expresses confidence in the workforce's dedication, asserting that Nvidia remains poised for success in the competitive AI landscape. Beware the Basin bluff! Gill's four-pacer plan looks beyond the first morning. With 15mm of grass on the pitch, India's skipper Gill plans to play four quicks and wants to be ready for what the surface will do on days four and five, not just the first morning 50 artworks from $300m university pledge face auction to repay developer's loan. In a fascinating turn of events, Seattle's Richard 'Dick' Hedreen is auctioning off around 50 pieces from his extensive art collection to settle a loan linked to it. Previously, he had pledged a stunning $300 million worth of artwork to Seattle University as a tribute to his late wife. Meanwhile, the university is committed to realizing plans for a new art museum, even though construction has hit a few snags. Trapped inside mosque in J and K's Kulgam, LeT commander Lateef Bhat refuses to surrender. Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Lateef Bhat, the only surviving local terrorist in the Valley, was trapped in an ongoing encounter in Kulgam district. 'My favourite cricket player': Bumrah, Rohit share special messages for MS Dhoni. Rohit Sharma and Jasprit Bumrah celebrated MS Dhoni's retirement from IPL, sharing their fond memories with him. Dhoni's remarkable playing career spans 17 seasons with the Chennai Super Kings and includes various achievements. He will serve as team mentor for CSK in the upcoming IPL 2027 season. Throughout his IPL journey, Dhoni established himself as a successful captain and reliable finisher. US midterms: Peltola defeats Sullivan as Democrats clinch 56-44 Senate majority. Democrat Mary Peltola has defeated Republican incumbent Senator Dan Sullivan in Alaska's US Senate race, flipping the ninth Republican-held seat to her party and giving Democrats a 56-44 majority in the chamber when the new Congress begins in January. Maryland tern nests rise from under 30 to 460 after floating habitat restoration. In Maryland's coastal bays, common terns have faced notable declines in population, primarily due to habitat destruction. However, since 2020, conservation initiatives have restored nesting opportunities, including a new floating platform. By 2026, researchers observed 460 nests, with various other bird species now using this habitat. Ongoing restoration of natural islands is crucial to sustain these positive outcomes for the future. Sehwag's parenting lesson: Sons learn value of money beyond famous dad's shadow. Virender Sehwag shared insights on how his sons manage their earnings from cricket. After paying for petrol, they experienced the cost implications firsthand. They are learning to prioritize meaningful achievements over material possessions. Sehwag prepares them for comparisons with his cricket achievements to focus on their own paths.
